summary:
Turn 68 aligned the map's codec entry with all three confirmed scenarios of that finding.

State on entry. Claim C10 now has three reviewed-vs-pending scenarios from one root cause: the value truncation (70000 bytes written, 4464 decoded) and the following command decoding to garbage, both confirmed, and the receiver-side decoder panic on a real PreAccept (makeslice: len out of range), whose review was submitted last turn. The map's codec surface and open detail still described only the first scenario.

Map update (accepted base version 13, two clarified objects). The core_overview open detail now states all three confirmed consequences — the truncated value, the garbage following command in the same buffer, and the decode panic that the receiver's reader has no recover for — with the default 1000-byte command boundary and the unread participant reaction kept explicit. The existing codec surface's reason and sources were extended to match, keeping its infrastructure disposition and its role as framing rather than protocol decision. Both objects have map_changes entries with sources and preserves explanations, so no requirement, binding, edge or identity moved.

Frontier. Ten claim families are settled: eight confirmed violations or consequences (C1 recovery divergence with its four artifacts, C2 durable-record layout, C3 applied-state divergence, C4 NOOP-commit crash, C6 promoted-leader variant, C7 dead accept-rejection path, C9 recorder row in two scenarios, C10 codec in three scenarios) and two bounded no-violation protections (C5 owner-alive re-proposal, C8 executor timeout enqueue). Two candidates remain paused with resume conditions, and the one administrative item — the scope issue on the superseded C1 artifact — is documented as structurally unresolvable with the mechanisms the validator accepts. Remaining unread items are named: the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream, whether the client caps the command size it builds, and whether any caller enables durable recording. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
